people.gloss: Tử Vi is the enclosure of the pole star, beneath the Canopy
people.role: Mistress of Hoa Cái Đường since 1141, pill refining from badland cinnabar and sulphur
people.appearance: A handsome woman of middle years in a vermilion coat, with a faint tremor in her left hand that she hides by holding a fan.
people.backstory: La Tử Vi was a pill-seller's daughter of Thạch Kiều Thành who walked up to the new Hall in 1100 because its pills were the only ones weighed at Thiên Quyền Thị like everything else (V117). The founder Úy Đan Dương (uy_dan_duong) made her his disciple. In 1141 the fumes of the eighth turn of his Canopy Pill blinded him, and the same month his co-founder Tôn Luyện Hà (ton_luyen_ha) died of the mercury. La Tử Vi took the furnace from his hands at fifty-one and has run the Hall since as a Trúc Cơ, which no one in the heartland expected to last. She made it last by trade. The Hall works the Pivot's own cinnabar diggings at Thần Sa Khoáng under lease, washes and refines the ore, and sells the refined cinnabar back to the Pivot with its wound pills. The Pivot's pill-maker Chúc Đan Sa (chuc_dan_sa) buys from her and is the friend she tells most of her recipes to. She is 110, and a Trúc Cơ has two hundred years. She takes the founder's unfinished pill in the open, and half the Hall admires her for it.
people.wants: To keep the Pivot's lease and the Hall's weight at the scale, and to finish the founder's Canopy Pill and reach Kết Đan by it before her years run out.
people.secret: The washers at Thần Sa Khoáng shake because the Hall roasts its poor ore beside the troughs, and Mục Hồng Sa's returns tell her so each season. Each spring she signs two Thanh Khoa boys onto the lease, and signs the sick off it as gone home to the farm, paid a third of the lease rate. She points to Dư Hoàng Nhi, who breathes the mercury room's air unmasked, as proof that the Breath protects anyone who does it right.

people.role: Founder of Hoa Cái Đường (1060), blinded by his own pill in 1141; lives in a sealed room at the Hall
people.appearance: A gaunt, silver-skinned old man with clouded eyes, who sits with his hands on a bronze gourd and smells the air before anyone speaks.
people.backstory: Úy Đan Dương was a cinnabar washer's son at Thần Sa Khoáng, the diggings the Pivot's alchemists opened in 300 (A208). He learned refining from the Pivot's own pill-makers without being admitted, and in 1060, at seventy, founded the Hall on the forest slope below the Pivot's seat with Tôn Luyện Hà (ton_luyen_ha) and a dozen washers (V117). He swore the Hall's pills would be weighed in the open market like the Pivot's ore. For eighty years he worked on one pill, the Canopy Pill, a nine-turn cinnabar elixir that was to carry a Trúc Cơ through Kết Đan without a tribulation's luck. In 1141 the eighth turn blew back in his face. It blinded him and the fumes killed Tôn in the next room. He gave the furnace to his disciple La Tử Vi (la_tu_vi) and has lived since in a sealed room, smelling batches she brings him. The ninth turn of the pill is still in his gourd, and the market's book has listed the Canopy Pill as a failure since 1141.
people.wants: For someone to finish the ninth turn and pour it out, and for it not to be La Tử Vi.
people.secret: He is teaching Châu Dĩ An the ninth turn by smell, as she sets down each meal, so that the pill is finished by someone who will pour it into the badland sand. La Tử Vi holds the key to the gourd and thinks he talks to the girl about market prices.

people.role: Master of the mercury room, the Hall's oldest refiner after the founder
people.appearance: A thin man in a leather mask with glass eyes, which he takes off only to eat.
people.backstory: A sulphur miner's son from Lưu Hoàng, where the badlands smell of eggs for twenty li (A209). He joined the Hall ten years before La Tử Vi (la_tu_vi) and expected the furnace in 1141. He keeps the Nine-Cycle Mercury Art and teaches it slowly, because he carried Tôn Luyện Hà (ton_luyen_ha) out of the refining room himself. He wants the roasting at the diggings carted back to his masked room at the seat, which would cost the Hall a season's weight at the scale, and La refuses.

people.role: Foreman of the Hall's lease at the Pivot's cinnabar diggings of Thần Sa Khoáng
people.appearance: A big red-handed woman whose teeth are pink from cinnabar dust.
people.backstory: Born at the diggings like the founder, she runs the forty washers the Hall keeps at Thần Sa Khoáng under the Pivot's lease (A208): the Pivot owns the mine, the Hall digs and washes it, and every basket is weighed at Thiên Quyền Thị. To keep the baskets full she roasts the poor ore beside the troughs, and the washers who stand in them shake. She sends the sick home to Thanh Khoa with a third of the lease rate and a pouch of herb sleeping pills bought from the Pivot's pill-maker, and puts two new boys at the troughs in their place. La Tử Vi (la_tu_vi) is her friend and her mistress.

people.role: Co-founder of Hoa Cái Đường (1060), killed by the founder's pill in 1141
people.backstory: A cinnabar washer of Thần Sa Khoáng and Úy Đan Dương's (uy_dan_duong) Dao partner, who founded the Hall with him in 1060 (V117). She learned the mercury art first, taught La Tử Vi (la_tu_vi) the furnace, and died in the next room when the eighth turn of the Canopy Pill blew back in 1141. The Sulphur Lung Breath was made after her death so that no one else would die the same way.
